approximation.meaning: density fitting (RI) for both J and K (ORCA RIJK, Psi4 MEM_DF, PySCF density_fit)

native_input:
%maxcore 500
%pal nprocs 8 end

! HF RHF RIJK VeryTightSCF NoAutoStart Bohrs def2-svp
! numfreq

%scf
    thresh               1e-14
    tcut                 1e-15
    tole                 1e-12
    tolrmsp              1e-10
    tolmaxp              1e-09
    tolerr               1e-10
    tolg                 1e-09
    convcheckmode        0
    convforced           true
    directresetfreq      1
    maxiter              300
end
%basis
    auxjk                "def2/JK"
end
%method
    z_tol                1e-10
end
%freq
    centraldiff          true
    increment            0.002
end

* xyzfile 0 1 geometry.xyz
hessian_method: NumFreq: central differences of analytic gradients (increment 0.002 bohr)
hessian_source: orca.hess ($hessian) via qccodec parse_hessian (normal-mode check skipped)
dipole_source: orca.property.txt $SCF_Dipole_Moment (origin [-0.000489, 0.000629, 0.04263] bohr recovered from the nuclear contribution, shifted to (0, 0, 0))

settings.geometry: bohr via ! Bohrs (exact, no A->bohr round trip)

as_printed.RI: RI-approximation to the Coulomb term is turned on
